label: Parry
description: Deflect enemy attacks with perfect timing

parameters.label: Parry window (frames)
parameters.help: Frames during which a perfect block registers. Typical: 4-12.

parameters.label: Enemy stun duration (frames)
parameters.help: How long enemies are stunned after being parried.

parameters.label: Parry cooldown (frames)
parameters.help: Frames before parry can be used again.

parameters.label: Knockback force
parameters.help: How far enemies are pushed after parry.
